issue.title: test_saved_group_revive_restores_deleted_artifacts_and_tribe_real_loader sees three agents under broad suite
issue.description: Investigate the node-specific broad-suite failure proposed by sase-1oh.4.1.2, preserve the assertion, and prove the underlying isolation or scheduling fix. Root cause is not established, so size large is intentional. Search across all task statuses and recent tasks found no node-specific duplicate; retired umbrella sase-ct must not receive +1. Active sase-j7 concerns confirmed process-global leaks, but no causal mechanism has been established here. Proposed by sase-1oh.4.1.2 note #1. ToolRun b412703e30ebc1ac6c17565e3f554091 reported this node NEW in the parallel scoped lane: expect_state(agent_count, 1) timed out after 5 seconds with last value 3. Phase recorded all 26 tests in the three files passing serially both with and without its finalizer changes, at host load 40-64. Landing audit on clean sase c74a32c5c4 independently reran those three files serially and all passed (combined five-file run: 47 passed, only an unrelated capacity fixture failed). Observed once failing in the cited broad run, passing in the phase serial controls and current serial audit; population fail rate unknown. No failure-recovery product change in these files.
